Garlic Noodles

Buttery, garlicky, done in 15.
5 minutes 1 hour 10 minutes 4 servings Main Course Chinese, Asian noodles, garlic

Ingredients

Noodles

  • 8 oz lo mein noodles

Sauce:

  • ⅓ cup butter (unsalted)
  • 10 cloves garlic minced
  • 2 tbsp oyster sauce
  • Cook the noodles per the package.
  • Melt butter, add garlic, cook 2 minutes.
  • Toss everything together.
Use fresh noodles if you can.
